beats.summary: The characters prepare for a medical emergency and attempt to assist Pam during labor.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I got it! I got it! Everybody it's go time!

beats.summary: There is a disagreement about calling an ambulance and Jim's ability to drive.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: No, no, no. Ambulances are emergencies only. You call an ambulance, I call the cops.
Michael: No, Jim, you are in no condition to drive. I will drive you.

beats.summary: Dwight attempts to escort Michael to the hospital, including impersonating a police officer.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: I love escorting people. In fact, a few years back, I put an ad in the paper starting an escort service.
Policeman: Pull over! You're not allowed to impersonate a police officer!

beats.summary: Jim reports the dilation status of Pam and the progress of labor.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Pam's doing great. Uh, she's ten inches dilated now.
Nurse: Daddy? She's ready to push.

beats.summary: Michael shows concern and excitement about the birth of the baby.

evidence.snippet: Michael: That kid's going to have a lot of hair.
Pam (with Jim, holding the baby): She's incredible.

beats.summary: The characters discuss and prepare for the arrival of the baby, including getting items and waiting.

evidence.snippet: Andy: I decided to give baby Halpert a newspaper from the day she was born.
Phyllis: This is ridiculous. We just can't wait here.
